title: Take Profit and Stop Loss from chart
content:
When you have active position on the chart, simply click the position indicator and drag it up or down to create a TP (Take Profit bracket) or SL (Stop Loss bracket):
Adding a Take Profit & Stop Loss
After entering your TP and SL orders, you can modify the price level by simply clicking and dragging the order to your desired price level, or canceling them individually from the chart.
